result.grade_0_meaning: No signs of diabetic retinopathy were detected. Maintain your regular annual eye exams and keep blood sugar well-controlled.
result.grade_1_meaning: Early signs detected (microaneurysms). No immediate treatment needed, but strict blood sugar control is essential.
result.grade_2_meaning: Moderate disease present with possible fluid leakage. A comprehensive evaluation by an ophthalmologist is recommended.
result.grade_2_next: Consult an eye specialist within 3-6 months.
result.grade_3_meaning: Severe disease with high risk of vision loss. Prompt consultation with a retinal specialist is highly recommended.
result.grade_3_next: Consult a retinal specialist within 1-2 months.
result.grade_4_meaning: Advanced stage with new, fragile blood vessels (neovascularization). Urgent treatment is required to prevent severe vision loss.
result.grade_4_next: Seek immediate consultation with a retinal specialist.

eye_explorer.cornea_desc: The clear, dome-shaped surface that covers the front of the eye and helps focus light.
eye_explorer.lens_desc: The transparent structure behind the iris that focuses light onto the retina.
eye_explorer.vitreous_desc: The clear gel that fills the space between the lens and the retina.
eye_explorer.retina_desc: The light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye. Diabetes can damage its small blood vessels over time.
eye_explorer.macula_desc: The central part of the retina responsible for detailed central vision.
eye_explorer.optic_nerve_desc: The nerve that carries visual information from the eye to the brain.
eye_explorer.blood_vessels_desc: Diabetic retinopathy involves damage to small blood vessels in the retina.

about.hero_desc: RetinaFormer bridges the gap between advanced artificial intelligence and clinical ophthalmology, providing accessible, explainable diabetic retinopathy screening.
about.how_it_works_desc: Our pipeline utilizes state-of-the-art Vision Transformers to achieve expert-level accuracy.
about.step1_desc: High-resolution retinal image is captured and uploaded to the platform.
about.step2_desc: Image is standardized, normalized, and enhanced to highlight retinal structures.
about.step3_desc: Vision Transformers (ViT) analyze both global context and local fine-grained details.
about.step4_desc: The model predicts the severity grade on the 5-point international clinical scale.
about.step5_desc: Grad-CAM generates a heatmap overlay highlighting the regions that influenced the decision.
about.tech_arch_desc: The platform is built on a custom Vision Transformer architecture fine-tuned specifically for ophthalmic imagery. Unlike traditional CNNs, transformers capture long-range dependencies across the entire retina, allowing the model to correlate distant microaneurysms and hemorrhages with a high degree of precision.
about.data_privacy_desc: All retinal scans are processed securely and anonymously. Our platform adheres to strict data minimization principles, ensuring that images are never stored permanently unless explicitly authorized for research purposes. The Gemini Vision API integration ensures that state-of-the-art Explainable AI (XAI) analysis is generated dynamically without compromising patient confidentiality or violating HIPAA guidelines.
about.disclaimer: This platform is intended for educational and research purposes. It is not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis.

help.title: Help
help.how_upload_content: Click the upload area or drag and drop a retinal fundus image. Supported formats are JPG, JPEG, and PNG. The image should be a clear retinal photograph.
help.how_results_content: The result shows a grade (0-4) indicating the level of diabetic retinopathy features detected. The confidence percentage shows how certain the model is about its prediction. Always consult a healthcare professional for clinical interpretation.
help.how_gradcam_content: Grad-CAM creates a color map overlay on your image. Warm colors (red, orange) highlight areas that most influenced the AI's decision. Cool colors (blue) indicate less influential areas.
help.how_3d_content: Click and drag to rotate the model. Use scroll or pinch to zoom. Click on highlighted areas to learn about each structure. Switch to 2D view if 3D is not comfortable.
help.change_language_content: Use the language selector in the top navigation bar to switch between English, Hindi, and Telugu. All content will be translated.
help.restart_tour_desc: Would you like to see the guided tour again?
